subject.title: [Bug]: --to flag ignored when using --agent with custom channel, all sessions map to main

question: Should explicit `--agent --channel --to` routing use recipient-derived session keys, and if so must those keys be bounded or opaque before merge?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the active fix changes persisted session identity and can expose recipient identifiers, so maintainer intent is needed before the open PR or a replacement lands.

options.title: Refresh With Bounded Keys
options.body: Refresh the linked PR on current main, preserve `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or opaque recipient-key contract with upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept Raw Recipient Keys
options.body: Land raw channel/recipient-derived keys only if maintainers explicitly accept the persisted identifier contract and test the compatibility impact.

options.title: Require Explicit Session Selectors
options.body: Document that bridge operators must pass explicit session keys and leave the implicit `--agent --channel --to` main-session behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Refresh With Bounded Keys
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR on current main, preserve `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or opaque recipient-key contract with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active closing PR carrying the proposed resolver policy and implementation path.
